# `worker_request`

Area: **worker** ([all tables](README.md))

The admin UI's queue for the billing worker (ours): catch-up and retry requests. The API only inserts; the worker picks them up oldest first.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | no | `gen_random_uuid()` | Primary key, generated by the database (gen_random_uuid()). |
| `created_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no | `now()` | When the row was inserted: the database's now(), not the injected clock. Never used for billing decisions. |
| `updated_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no | `now()` | Last change: the database's now(), maintained by the set_updated_at trigger. |
| `kind` | `worker_request_kind` (enum, see [README](README.md#enums)) | no |  | catchUp or retry. |
| `up_to` | `date` | yes |  | catchUp: bill every due date up to this business date; set iff catchUp. |
| `run_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | retry: the failed run to retry; set iff retry. |
| `requested_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  | When the request was queued (injected clock); the queue order. |
| `requested_by` | `text` | yes |  | The operator from X-Remote-User, if any (display only). |
| `picked_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  | When the worker took it; a picked request of a dead worker is picked again. |
| `done_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  | When the worker finished it (also when it raised); NULL = pending. |

## Constraints

| Name | Kind | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| `worker_request_catch_up_has_date` | check | `CHECK (((kind = 'catchUp'::worker_request_kind) = (up_to IS NOT NULL)))` |
| `worker_request_done_after_picked` | check | `CHECK (((done_at IS NULL) OR ((picked_at IS NOT NULL) AND (done_at >= picked_at))))` |
| `worker_request_picked_after_requested` | check | `CHECK ((picked_at >= requested_at))` |
| `worker_request_retry_has_run` | check | `CHECK (((kind = 'retry'::worker_request_kind) = (run_id IS NOT NULL)))` |
| `worker_request_pkey` | primary key | `PRIMARY KEY (id)` |
